strings.component.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
strings.component.help: Analyzes mesh UVs, scales islands to a target quality, and packs atlases. Designed for VRChat avatars.
strings.opt.generateAtlas.help: If disabled, unused UVs are not trimmed and UVs are not rearranged. Whole textures are scaled instead.
strings.opt.npot.help: 64 px steps. Compatible with Mip Streaming and Crunch. Unsupported formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS) are removed.
strings.opt.whitelist.help: Any object type. Every Texture2D referenced by these objects skips all optimization.
strings.error.noDescriptor: ATO component is not on a VRCAvatarDescriptor
strings.error.noDescriptor:description: Avatar Texture Optimizer must be added to the same GameObject as VRCAvatarDescriptor.
strings.error.noDescriptor:hint: Move the component to the avatar root that has VRCAvatarDescriptor.
strings.error.multiple: Multiple ATO components on one avatar
strings.error.multiple:description: Only one AvatarTextureOptimizer is allowed on an avatar and its children. Found {0}.
strings.error.multiple:hint: Remove extra components, then bake again.
strings.error.canceled:description: The user canceled Avatar Texture Optimizer. Temporary assets on disk were kept. CPU/GPU/memory were released.
strings.warn.shader:description: Material {0} shader {1} could not be fully analyzed. Related textures were treated as whitelist.
strings.warn.shader:hint: Use lilToon or a shader with standard texture keywords, or add the material to the whitelist yourself.
strings.warn.uvWrap:description: Renderer {0} UV{1} has islands that depend on Repeat wrapping. Treated as whitelist.
strings.warn.uvWrap:hint: Unwrap the mesh so islands sit in 0-1 without crossing the seam.
strings.warn.atlasFail: Texture did not fit any atlas
strings.warn.atlasFail:description: Texture {0} (UV group {1}) cannot fit the max atlas. Atlas packing was skipped for that UV group.
strings.warn.atlasFail:hint: Reduce island size, raise max atlas, or disable atlas generation.
strings.warn.grayFallback:description: Texture {0} was requested as single-channel but contains multiple used channels. Saved as multi-channel.
strings.warn.grayFallback:hint: This is a safety fallback; appearance is preserved.
strings.warn.st:description: Property {0} on {1} uses scale/offset/rotation (or animation). Treated as whitelist.
strings.report:hint: Expand the log in the Console for per-atlas details when Verbose Log is on.
